Applicability, Roles and Establishments
Assess territorial scope, processing context, controller and processor roles
Records of Processing and Data Flows
Document purposes, data categories, individuals, recipients, transfers, retention, systems
Lawful Basis and Transparency
Review lawful-basis decisions, privacy notices, consent mechanisms
Data Subject Rights
Design intake, identity verification, search, review, response, exception
Privacy by Design and DPIAs
Embed privacy checkpoints into projects and establish screening
Processor and Contract Governance
Assess processor due diligence, Article 28 control needs, instructions, subprocessors
International Transfers
Inventory transfer scenarios and organize the operational inputs required for the selected
Security and Breach Management
Align personal-data risk with technical and organizational measures, breach assessment
1. Applicability and Scope
Identify entities, establishments, services, individuals, data flows and likely GDPR roles
2. Discovery and Mapping
Review stakeholders, systems, vendors, documents, data journeys and existing evidence
3. Gap and Risk Assessment
Evaluate design and operation of privacy practices and prioritize material deficiencies
4. Remediation Design
Define policies, procedures, control improvements, technology changes, ownership
5. Implementation Support
Help teams operationalize records, notices, rights, DPIAs, vendor controls, retention, security
6. Training and Testing
Train relevant roles and test selected workflows using realistic scenarios
7. Governance and Improvement
Establish reporting, review cadence, monitoring, issue management and change triggers
